answer_1.quote: Recent work has made substantial progress by designing sequence-to-sequence neural models that "translate" complex sentences into simplified versions.

answer_2.quote: We report SARI scores ... we also explore semantic similarity measures such as Jaccard, Cosine (GloVe), Cosine (ELMo), Cosine (Sentence BERT), and BERTScore, as well as factuality classifiers FACT-CC and DAE.

answer_4.quote: We use Amazon Mechanical Turk to acquire labels for reference examples from datasets, and for model-generated simplifications. ... each example was annotated by 3 workers. The final label for each category ... was set to the majority label.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators applied a three‑category labeling scheme (Insertion, Deletion, Substitution) with severity levels 0, 1, 2, and -1 to assess factuality of the simplified sentence.
